title: El que vende en el bus
goal: Buy something from somebody selling in the aisle at speed
culture: Vendors board at every stop, work the aisle and jump off before the bus is properly moving. You have about twenty seconds, so the Spanish is short and the money should already be in your hand.

beats.good: ¿Qué lleva? is what are you carrying, and it is the fastest possible question — which matters, because he is leaving.
Deme uno — give me one. Shorter than me da and right for the speed this is happening at.
Have the note ready before you ask. He is getting off at the next corner whether the transaction is finished or not.

beats.objective: Thank him as he jumps off
beats.good: Joven is what you call any young man you are not going to name. He is fourteen and he has three more buses to work before dark.
